items.title: Special right to terminate the electricity contract before the price increase takes effect
items.quote: Sie haben das Recht, Ihren Vertrag ohne Einhaltung einer Kündigungsfrist zum Zeitpunkt des Wirksamwerdens der Preisänderung zu kündigen (§ 41 Abs. 5 EnWG).
items.computation: The price increase becomes effective on 01.01.2026 ('Anpassung Ihrer Strompreise zum 01.01.2026'). § 41 Abs. 5 EnWG gives the customer a special right to terminate without notice period, effective at the moment the new price would start to apply. To end the contract before the higher price applies (i.e. effective 01.01.2026), the termination in text form must reach Beispiel Energie AG at the latest one day before, i.e. by 31.12.2025 (§ 188 Abs. 1 BGB, counting back one day from 01.01.2026). 31.12.2025 is a Wednesday, so no weekend/holiday shift is needed. The letter itself does not print this date explicitly; it is derived from the stated effective date of the price change.

warnings: The letter does not print an explicit deadline for exercising the special termination right; the 31.12.2025 date is derived from the stated 01.01.2026 effective date of the price increase and should be confirmed if a lot is at stake.

Cancellation must be in text form ('Textform') and reach the provider by the deadline, not merely be sent by then; sending well before 31.12.2025 (e.g. by 23.12.2025) is advisable to allow for postal transit.
